name: Finale of Devastation — +X/+X and haste only if X is 10 or more
notes: Found in the sweep diff for the "If X is N or more" branch (2026-10-06). "If X is 10 or more, creatures you control get +X/+X and gain haste until end of turn." applied at every X (X = 2 gave +2/+2 and haste). It is now behind the comparison. Player 1 casts it with X = 2: Grizzly Bears stay 2/2 without haste. The opponent casts it with X = 10: their Hill Giant is 13/13 with haste.
